policies.title: Niue: named visitor-waiver passports receive 30-day visitor permit on arrival
policies.summary: Niue Tourism expressly says citizens in its named waiver list need not apply before travel and may receive a 30-day visitor permit on arrival. Because the admission document is issued on arrival, this is normalized as visa_on_arrival rather than visa_free.
conditions: The current tourism entry page explicitly identifies a waiver list, says no visa application is needed before travel, and expressly places issuance of a 30-day visitor permit on arrival. Only unambiguous project passport-code country matches are mapped; New Caledonia is not a project passport code.

The ordinary-passport abstraction does not establish diplomatic, official, emergency, temporary, refugee, stateless, crew, transit, work, study, residence, returnee, Niuean-origin or discretionary-admission treatment.

Visitors must have a passport valid at least three months after arrival, pre-booked accommodation, sufficient funds and a return/onward ticket. The source states admission may be refused; these are conditions, not a separate ETA/eVisa status.

policies.title: Niue: other directly modelled foreign visitors require advance visitor visa
policies.summary: The current Niue Tourism entry page expressly says all other travellers must apply for a visitor visa before travel. This is a prior-visa route, not an electronic visa or arrival permit.
conditions: This applies through the page’s explicit “all other travellers” instruction, not an inferred complement from an omitted nationality list. It is corroborated by the current Government of Niue Immigration form, which says travellers not from its named countries must apply for a visitor permit.

The current application form calls for passport information, itinerary, booked accommodation, fee and further material requested by the Chief Immigration Officer; its stated processing time is 7 to 14 days. It is not an electronic issuance route.
This does not establish work, study, residence, transit, crew, special/diplomatic passport, returnee, Niuean-origin, New Zealand status, discretionary-admission or third-country-document treatment.

application.label: Government of Niue Immigration visitor visa application form
application.processingTime: 7 to 14 days when the stated form and documents are complete.
steps: Complete the Government of Niue Immigration visitor visa form.
Submit the stated passport biodata, itinerary, booked accommodation, application fee and any material requested by the Chief Immigration Officer.
Receive the decision before travel; the form says the visa is sent after processing.

unresolved.reason: The live waiver list conditions United Kingdom treatment on permanent residence/right of permanent residence in the UK. A GB passport code alone does not establish that condition, and the passport-wide advance-visa alternative is not inferred.

The detailed live waiver list omits New Zealand, its FAQ separately says the waiver cohort includes New Zealand, and the same page describes Niuean/descendant exemption stickers in New Zealand passports. The sources do not establish one ordinary NZ-passport rule independent of Niuean origin or sticker status.

The live waiver list conditions Portugal treatment on permanent residence in Portugal. A PT passport code alone does not establish that condition, and the passport-wide advance-visa alternative is not inferred.
